synthesis: Makati's PSA-reported average annual resident-population growth accelerated in 2020–2024 after slowing in the prior interval, while population rose by 17,027 on the current 23-barangay boundary.
boundaries: Uses the PSA-published average annual growth rate rather than recomputing a simple calendar-year CAGR.
Uses the comparable current Makati 23-barangay boundary.
Does not infer why growth accelerated.
Does not treat resident population as daytime population.
